chunks: 2463 - He said: And I heard him say:

"Whoever leaves his house, or a house other than his house, at the beginning of the morning, then meets a chestnut horse with white markings, blessing is granted to him in his day. And if it has a flowing blaze, then it is prosperity, and he will encounter nothing on that day but joy, and Allah, Mighty and Majestic, fulfills his need."

key_terms.أَوَّلِ الْغَدَاةِ: the earliest part of the morning
key_terms.غُرَّةٌ سَائِلَةٌ: a flowing white blaze on the horse's face

ai.seo_question: What does seeing a chestnut horse with white markings in the morning signify in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes an auspicious sign encountered at the start of the day: seeing a chestnut horse marked with whiteness. It associates that sight with blessing, joy, prosperity, and the fulfillment of one's need by Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2463 - And I heard him (Imam (as)) say:

"Whoever leaves their house, or any other house, early in the morning and encounters a chestnut horse (ashqar) with white markings (awdah), their day will be blessed. If the horse has a prominent flowing white blaze (ghurra saila), it signifies prosperity, and they will experience joy throughout that day. Moreover, Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious, will fulfill their needs."
